'''Sayuri Hara''' (Japanese: '''原紗友里''' ''Hara Sayuri'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hara was born on November 5, 1988, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and she became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with {{wp|81 Produce}}. Hara became involved with the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, voicing [[Team Flare]] scientist [[Mable]] as well as [[Lilia]], a girl who briefly proposed to {{an|Clemont}}.
